messages:
kevin: quick q — how should we propagate scoped claims (console roles/scopes) to downstream inference routing? tenant-affinity + quota needs to see scope info.

anna: do you mean in the JWT that we hand to routing, or via a separate introspect call?

kevin: leaning JWT embed. fewer round trips. but worried about token bloat and stale role changes. example: `claims: { tenant: T123, scopes: [routes:read, generate:limited], affinity: region-us }`

samira: jwt works but we need revocation. idea: short-lived jwt + long-lived refresh with introspect. also: add `scope_version` int so console rollouts can bump.

marco: console UX question — we surface "effective scopes" today only at tenant level. we need route-level toggles and a preview of what an issued token will contain. otherwise support gets flooded.

anna: yes — preview pane + copy-as-token button. safe default: don't include route-level granular claims in hosted tokens unless tenant opts in. enterprise can opt-into scoped tokens.

kevin: telemetry: we should emit `perm.check` events on routing side with tags {tenant, route, required_scope, token_scope, outcome}. will help detect mismatches during rollout.

samira: agree. also emit `scope.version.mismatch` when token `scope_version` != current tenant `scope_version`. can drive rollout auto-alerts.

marco: UI rollout plan: feature flag per org, show a "token preview" beta ribbon, and an in-console migration guide. small canary: 5 early enterprise tenants.

kevin: API surface: suggest adding `POST /v1/tokens:issue` payload option `include_route_claims: boolean` and response `issued_token`, `scope_version`. v2 if ppl want to avoid churn.

samira: alternative: keep `issue` unchanged and add `introspect` enhancement that returns `effective_scopes` + `scope_version`. routing can call introspect on token for final decision if teams want strict revocation.

marco: introspect adds latency at routing. if routing calls introspect per request it kills P99. could cache introspect result per token-id with TTL = token TTL.

kevin: caching is fine but must be invalidated on scope changes. we need a "scope-change invalidation" pubsub event that routing caches subscribe to.

samira: infra note: pubsub -> routing nodes -> invalidate local cache. we already have this pattern for model config rollouts. reuse it.

infra-bot: deploy: `canary/kevin-scoped-claims` started for eng-platform on 2026-03-19 15:12 UTC :truck:`

anna: next steps: 1) samira to draft API options (issue vs introspect) 2) marco to wire up token preview UI sketch 3) kevin to spec telemetry events + metric names 4) ops to start pubsub invalidation prototype.

kevin: sounds good. timeline: aim for internal canary in 2 weeks. keep feature gated. :thumbsup:

marco: small UX nit — in preview show both `compact` and `expanded` claim views, and highlight any tenant policies that will be overridden by route-level scopes.

samira: I'll include `scope_version` bump endpoint in the plan: `POST /v1/tenants/{id}/scope_version:increment` with dry-run option.

kevin: perfect. thanks all — I'll open a tracking RFC with the API + rollout checklist after this thread.

anna: thanks! :party-parrot:
